verdict.rationale: jo is described as a cloud-hosted personal agent where each user gets an isolated cloud machine (Fly.io-style architecture) that jo itself provisions and manages — there is no mention of a self-hosted deployment option, open-source release, or on-prem installation path. The evidence explicitly frames jo's own cloud machine as 'belonging only to you' but still operated by jo's infrastructure, not something the user runs on their own hardware.
